item.title: BAE Systems wins Paladin howitzer production deal
item.description: The award covers the manufacture of 40 further M109A7 Paladin sets, including the associated M992A3 Carrier Ammunition Tracked vehicles used to support artillery operations. The post BAE Systems wins Paladin howitzer production deal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: BAE wins U.S. Navy ship repair contracts in San Diego
item.description: BAE Systems San Diego shipyard has secured two U.S. Navy contracts to carry out scheduled modernisation and maintenance work on two frontline surface combatants, the company stated. The post BAE wins U.S. Navy ship repair contracts in San Diego first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Navantia UK marks one year since Harland and Wolff buy
item.description: Navantia UK has marked one year since completing its acquisition of Harland and Wolff, pointing to major investment in shipyard infrastructure and workforce growth. The post Navantia UK marks one year since Harland and Wolff buy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Wallace warns modern warfare strains military data security
item.description: Former defence secretary Sir Ben Wallace has told MPs that the Afghan data breach exposed deeper structural problems in how sensitive information is handled during modern military operations. The post Wallace warns modern warfare strains military data security first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British Army reviews gun options for Ares vehicles
item.description: The Northrop Grumman M230LF dual-feed Bushmaster chain gun is being assessed for Ares. The post British Army reviews gun options for Ares vehicles first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British spy plane circles Russian territory in Baltic
item.description: A Royal Air Force RC-135W Rivet Joint electronic surveillance aircraft has conducted a patrol orbiting the Russian territory of Kaliningrad. The post British spy plane circles Russian territory in Baltic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Warning that inflation risk could hit defence procurement
item.description: The Defence Committee heard this week that failure to reform defence finance and procurement could drive inflation across major equipment programmes, as MPs pressed the Government on access to private capital and the rising cost of military capability. The post Warning that inflation risk could hit defence procurement first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MPs hear calls to back Scottish aero skills at Prestwick
item.description: Industry representatives have urged stronger public-sector support for Scottish aerospace and defence sector, warning that future skills and jobs depend on sustained government backing, according to evidence heard by the Scottish Affairs Committee. The post MPs hear calls to back Scottish aero skills at Prestwick first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Russian cargo vessel ordered to leave British waters
item.description: A Russian-flagged cargo vessel observed operating within approximately 3 kilometres of the UK coastline near Minehead has been ordered to leave UK waters. The post Russian cargo vessel ordered to leave British waters first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Lanarkshire chosen for new UK AI growth zone
item.description: Lanarkshire in Scotland has been named as the location for the latest AI Growth Zone, a development expected to support more than 3,400 jobs and attract billions of pounds in private investment. The post Lanarkshire chosen for new UK AI growth zone first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
